name: Being Two Faced
overview: Scripture condemns being two faced by emphasizing the importance of truthfulness and purity of heart. God commands His people not to bear false witness or swear falsely, highlighting the sin of deceitful speech against others. The Psalms contrast smooth, flattering words that conceal harmful intentions with the call for clean hands and a pure heart, warning that inward corruption defies God's blessing. True blessedness comes from sincerity and purity, as those who are pure in heart will see God, underscoring the call to integrity in both word and deed.
